description: Non-material amendment to the planning permission reference: 2024/02201/FUL dated 24th September 2025 for the "Redevelopment of the site to include, change of use of the existing property from a school (Class F1) to a mixed use (Class E) at basement and ground floor level and conversion of first, second, third and fourth floor level into 7no. self-contained flats (Class C3); alterations to include, removal of existing fire escape staircase to the rear of the building, erection of a three storey extension with an undercroft below and a roof terrace above; addition of rear metal balconies/terraces at first, second and third floor level; installation of 2no. air source heat pumps, metal door, decking, balustrade, steps, cycle gutter, and roller shutter to the rear ground floor elevation, creation of residential entrance to the front elevation, and erection of 1.8m high security gate in connection with the formation of a gated side access for cycle parking, cycle and bin stores at ground floor level; associated alterations." Amendments sought for the reconfiguration of the internal layout to relocate the bedroom to the front of the building and the kitchen to the rear; the introduction of a new utility room and WC at landing level serving Flat 7, in place of the previously approved reduced headroom storage area; and the relocation of the approved ASHP provision, together with the installation of additional Air Source Heat Pumps (ASHPs) within the rear courtyard.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission: 

1251 201; 1251 202; 1251 203; 1251 204; 1251 205; 1251 206; 1251 207; 1251 208; 1251 209; 1251 210; 1251 211 Rev A; 1251 212 (Proposed Section AA); 1251 212 (Proposed Section BB); Environmental Noise Survey and Plant Noise Assessment Report (Ref: 33186/PNA1, dated June 2026).

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 2 - The external sound level emitted from the Air Source Heat Pumps hereby approved shall not exceed the Plant Noise Emission Criteria specified in Table 4 of the Environmental Noise Survey and Plant Noise Assessment Report Ref. 33186/PNA1, prepared by Hann Tucker Associates and dated 22 June 2026. The assessment shall be undertaken in accordance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019 at the nearest and/or most affected noise-sensitive premises, with all relevant plant operating simultaneously at maximum capacity. The approved mitigation measures shall be implemented prior to first operation of the plant and thereafter permanently retained.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from mechanical plant, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 3 - Prior to first operation, the Air Source Heat Pumps hereby approved shall be installed on proprietary anti-vibration isolators and shall thereafter be maintained so as to prevent the transmission of vibration and regenerated noise to adjoining premises.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration from mechanical plant, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
